projects.title: ScreenExtend
projects.description: • Built a cross-platform desktop app that turns any browser device into a wireless extended monitor with zero client install, provisioning a per-client signed virtual display driver (Windows IDD) sized to each device's screen metrics and streaming it back over WebRTC as an independent monitor• Engineered a GPU capture-to-encode pipeline using Windows Graphics Capture with a hand-written DXGI Desktop Duplication fallback (D3D11 shader cursor compositing), feeding NV12 textures into NVENC/Quick Sync FFI bindings for hardware H.264 with a software-decode WebCodecs client fallback• Designed a closed-loop adaptive bitrate controller fusing EWMA-smoothed bandwidth estimates with loss-based rate estimation over REMB / transport-cc RTCP feedback, using asymmetric raise/cut thresholds and rate limiting to react to congestion within 250 ms while suppressing oscillation• Authored a custom little-endian binary input protocol over a WebRTC data channel carrying pointer/pen/touch (pressure, tilt, twist, coalesced move batches), keyboard, wheel, IME composition, clipboard, and file drag-and-drop, injected into the virtual display with ping/pong RTT probing for latency telemetry• Implemented WHEP signaling over a per-adapter axum HTTPS server with runtime self-signed TLS (rustls/rcgen), applying live per-device resolution/orientation/refresh/quality changes via SDP renegotiation without tearing down the display, plus offline ad-hoc Wi-Fi hosted-network mode and TURN relay for cross-network joins

projects.title: Independent Sports Analytics Research
projects.description: • Fine-tuned TrackNetV3 (U-Net heatmap detector consuming 3 consecutive frames) on self-collected match footage, localizing shuttles at 30 FPS with 100+ km/h smash motion blur and partial occlusion• Built unscented Kalman filter combining per-frame heatmap likelihoods with a physics-based state transition (gravity + simulated birdie drag), calculating 6-DOF shuttle state and minimizing ghost motion effects• Converted 2D to 3D coordinates by combining court-keypoint homography with physics-constrained trajectory fitting (reprojection error minimized according to drag dynamics), extracting height and speed from video• Combined YOLOv8 + ByteTrack player tracking with RTMPose joint estimation to segment strokes at contact points and classify 18 shot types matching ShuttleSet schema, producing structured stroke tokens from raw match videos• Modeled badminton shot selection as Markov chain over auto-extracted stroke tokens across hundreds of rallies, predicting next-shot placement and optimal doubles positioning; co-authoring research paper with UC Berkeley undergrad on stochastic game-theoretic strategy modeling, generalizing the approach to other racquet sports

projects.title: Funding Your Futures
projects.description: • Designed and built end-to-end financial literacy simulation platform solo in 3 months, deployed at gym-scale events where 200+ high schoolers across 2 years navigate 9 physical stations making real-time spending, saving, and insurance decisions on school-issued tablets• Architected real-time multi-role system (student + admin) over Server-Sent Events, syncing purchase state, life-event triggers, and session lifecycle across all connected clients with sub-second latency; admin dashboard supports live monitoring, per-student balance edits, and CSV export• Integrated Amazon Bedrock (Claude) to generate diverse AI character profiles per student and produce personalized letter-grade reports with spending analysis• Secured $2.5k in funding from Mission City Federal Credit Union for student-led initiative now expanding to additional Santa Clara district high schools

projects.title: Robotics Control Systems
projects.description: • Implemented mecanum drive inverse kinematics from scratch in Java, enabling smooth omnidirectional control during teleop that contributed to first place Inspire award• Tuned PIDF velocity controllers on flywheel shooter, holding steady-state velocity error under 15 RPM and achieving 86% autonomous shot accuracy across 10 matches at season tournaments• Deployed OpenCV AprilTag detection at 30 FPS on Android control hub, using quaternion-based rotation to eliminate gimbal lock during pose estimation; enabled autonomous alignment to scoring zones• Mentored 4 JV programmers on Java data structures and RoadRunner trajectory planning; 4 promoted to varsity in following season
